name: MFGROUP
recent: Manforce Group Berhad 近期获得一份价值 RM9.4 million 的外劳管理合约，相关新闻于 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布。公司截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日的季度营收为 RM42.19 million，净利 RM1.40 million，净利率 3.3%，较上一季度的 -6.7% 转正。此外，公司于 2026 年 9 月向尼泊尔总理救灾基金捐款 NPR 562,000。
notable: 获得价值 RM9.4 million 的外劳管理合约。

recent_en: Manforce Group Berhad recently secured a RM9.4 million foreign worker management contract, announced in the news on 19 November 2026. For the quarter ended 31 August 2026, revenue was RM42.19 million with net income of RM1.40 million and a net margin of 3.3%, turning positive from -6.7% in the prior quarter. The company also donated NPR 562,000 to Nepal's Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund in September 2026.
notable_en: Secured a foreign worker management contract worth RM9.4 million.
Net margin for the quarter ended 31 August 2026 turned positive to 3.3% from negative.
Donated NPR 562,000 to Nepal's Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund.
earnings_en: Revenue for the quarter ended 31 August 2026 was RM42.19 million, up 3.4% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM1.40 million with a net margin of 3.3%, improving from -6.7% in the prior quarter.
